# Glossary and Data Dictionary

Choose a topic below. Concepts and named quantities are kept together, with their Glossary or DataDictionary classification shown. Short definitions are visible; input layouts, lookup commands and interpretation notes are expandable.

These pages present the **current documented entries**. They do not claim to cover every public function or returned quantity. The full function/test inventory is deferred until the remaining functionality has been evaluated.

Definitions have one editable source: the [shared glossary](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES-MOCKUP.md). Each entry has one topic-page location; related pages link to it. Rebuild these views after editing the source. MATLAB reads that same source directly.

## Find an entry

Use the [alphabetical index](terms.md), browser Find on a topic page, or `farmGlossary("search", "distance")` in MATLAB. [MATLAB lookup and getters](../MATLAB-GLOSSARY.md) explain section filters and exact spelling.

The current source contains **107 entries**, including **10 Data Dictionary quantities**. The dictionary currently covers sampling diagnostics; it is not a complete list of requestable statistics.

## Reading the labels

**Construct** identifies an item with a defined FARM role and documented representation. A **construct instance** is a workflow variable holding one of those items. A container type such as struct or table is not automatically a construct. These labels describe roles and do not change the MATLAB entry schema.

**Inputs** reproduces the source layout. Some layouts describe generated results; read the interpretation notes before treating fields as constructor arguments. An entry with no documented layout displays `Inputs: {''}`.

Mesh and sheet entries remain available to interpret historical material. Those operations are deferred, as are ND2 and the two historical estimators. A definition does not establish release support.
